Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In Step 11, the Planner incorrectly swapped the release dates and countries for the two films in its "Updated Understanding" and subsequent decision. It stated that "My Wife's Lodger (1952) has an earliest release date in December 1962 (Italy)" and "Tiger of the Seven Seas (1962) has an earliest release date in October 1952 (United Kingdom)." This is a direct contradiction of the verified data gathered in Step 10 (where My Wife's Lodger was confirmed as UK, Oct 1952 and Tiger of the Seven Seas as Italy, Dec 23, 1962). This factual inversion led the Planner to conclude that Tiger of the Seven Seas was released earlier, which is the opposite of the correct answer (My Wife's Lodger, 1952).
